items.title: 3 High-Yield Dividend Stocks to Buy Now and 2 to Avoid Despite the Yield
items.summary: Among high-yield dividend stocks, there are some diamonds in the rough, but beware of the "yield traps" as well.

items.title: 4 High-Yield REITs Retirees Should Put on Their Buy List for Next Week
items.summary: With Treasuries paying more than 5%, a fat headline yield no longer cuts it for retirees. Four REITs claim they can still beat the bond market, but one of them carries a risk that hinges on Las Vegas spending.

items.title: How to Build $9,450 a Month in Dividend Income Without Selling a Single Share
items.summary: A 12% yield sounds like the fastest route to a paycheck without selling shares. But one slower-paying approach can outgrow it, and inflation quietly punishes the flashy choice. Which six holdings make the math work?

items.title: VICI Properties Faces Higher Credit Provisions: Can Risks Ease?
items.summary: VICI's $458 million credit loss provision hit third-quarter earnings, but rising AFFO highlights underlying growth.

items.title: 3 REIT Giants Paying Big Dividends, Led by VICI’s 7.6% Yield
items.summary: One of these REIT giants slashed its dividend, another leans on two casino tenants for 70% of its rent, and the third pays the biggest check per share. Cash flow math reveals which payouts deserve your trust.

items.title: Meet Wall Street’s Reliable High-Yield Dividend Stocks: 5 Companies That Pass the Yield Trap Test
items.summary: Treasuries now pay 5.12%, so a shaky dividend has nowhere to hide. We ran pipelines and landlords through a coverage test built for each business, and only a handful of payouts held up under the numbers.

items.title: Can Shares Rally Higher on VICI's $2B Buyback Plan & Raised Outlook?
items.summary: VICI's $2B buyback authorization, raised 2026 AFFO outlook and 7.4% dividend yield bolster its appeal, but tenant risks and funding questions cloud its rally.

items.title: 5 High-Yield Dividend Stocks to Buy in December With Yields Up to 7.3%
items.summary: Five dividend payers, five sectors, and one question after earnings season: whose payout is actually covered? One casino landlord, one fund manager, and a parcel carrier all face tests that the yield alone will not reveal.
